summary: Post-R272 Noether source-audit wave. Five LocalCodex Paper 40 slice packages form a contiguous sourcefix chain over printed pp.514-541. Paper 41 pp.411-419 contributes one source-visible printed-spelling patch under GDZ400 evidence. Paper 42 pp.5-15 is a best-available360 no-patch audit. R273 is a separate/narrow Paper 40 pp.514-520 branch and must not be treated as superseding the LocalCodex pp.520-541/P41/P42 chain.
global_caveat: These artifacts are source-audit/sourcefix/current-control support only. P40/P41 witnesses are mostly GDZ full-resolution around 400ppi; P42 is best-available around 360ppi. They are not Noether closure, not multilingual synchronization, not whole-paper certification, not strict native650/1000dpi source closure, and not critical-edition material.
